subject: English
question_text: Complete the following passage using suitable connectors:
stimulus: ⎯⎯ ⎯⎯ (a) taking food, we should bear in mind (b) we do not eat just to satisfy hunger or to ⎯⎯ fill the belly. We eat (c) we can preserve our health. Some people living in the midst of plenty, do not eat the food they need for good health (d) ⎯⎯ they have no knowledge of the science of health and nutrition. (e) ⎯⎯, they suffer from various diseases.
guide_solution: (a) While (b) that (c) so that (d) because (e) Consequently/ As a result/ That is why
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Barishal Board-2018 (Board Question With Solution)
flag_note: Gap letters in question ['d', 'e'] differ from solution letters ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'].
